traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION are satisfied by the current implementation: - Core functionality: The `valid-req-reference` rule, backed by `valid-req-reference-helpers`, validates that every @req (and each ID in @supports) refers to an existing requirement ID in the referenced story file, using regex-based parsing and per-file caching. - Quality standards: The implementation is markdown-structure-agnostic and successfully handles requirements embedded in different formats (plain text, bullet lists, multi-story fixtures). The generic `REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+` matcher ensures IDs in numbered lists, checkboxes, and multiple sections are equally supported. - Integration: Deep validation is wired through the central plugin index, included in recommended/strict configs, and reuses the existing annotation parsing patterns, as well as participating in flat-config preset tests. - User experience: Error messages for missing requirements (`reqMissing`) and invalid paths (`invalidPath`) are concise, specific, and tested, fulfilling the UX expectations in this and the Error Reporting story. - Error handling: Path validation prevents traversal and absolute paths, while file read/parsing errors are caught and surfaced as normal `reqMissing` diagnostics rather than crashes, matching the “gracefully handles malformed story files or parsing errors” goal. - Documentation: Both user-facing (user-docs/api-reference.md) and internal rule docs (docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md) clearly describe the behavior, configuration, and examples of supported patterns, explicitly referencing this story. Targeted and full jest runs confirm that all tests tied to this story pass, providing concrete verification that the implemented behavior meets the specification. Therefore the story is fully implemented and marked PASSED.
